# MAGIC ## Create Feature Table accounts9ad208

# COMMAND ----------

# Load the CSV files from workspace
batch1_path = "/Workspace/Users/benedict@logicalclocks.com/mlpab37b986/batch_1.csv"
batch2_path = "/Workspace/Users/benedict@logicalclocks.com/mlpab37b986/batch_2.csv"
batch3_path = "/Workspace/Users/benedict@logicalclocks.com/mlpab37b986/batch_3.csv"

# COMMAND ----------

# Read all batches
df1 = spark.read.csv(batch1_path, header=True, inferSchema=True)
df2 = spark.read.csv(batch2_path, header=True, inferSchema=True)
df3 = spark.read.csv(batch3_path, header=True, inferSchema=True)

# COMMAND ----------

all_df = df1.union(df2).union(df3)

# COMMAND ----------

from pyspark.sql.functions import row_number, col

                .drop("rank")

schema_name = "mlpab37b986"
